name: ambiguous-ai
description: Ambiguous Workspace — docs, sheets, slides, wiki, tasks, CRM, calendar, mail, chat and Drive in one place, for people and AI teammates.

plugins.name: ambiguous
plugins.description: Ambiguous is a workspace where people and AI teammates work side by side — docs, sheets, slides, wiki, tasks, CRM, calendar, mail, chat and Drive in one place, over one set of records and one permission model. This plugin lets Claude work in that workspace the way a colleague would: resolve a link someone pasted, read the planning doc before changing it, file tasks from a meeting note, update a CRM record after a call. Claude acts with exactly the permissions your own account has, never more. Sign-in is OAuth — run claude mcp login ambiguous after installing.

plugins.name: ambiguous-agent
plugins.description: Ambiguous Workspace integration for a provisioned AI coworker. Same workspace surface as the ambiguous plugin — docs, sheets, slides, wiki pages, tasks, CRM records, calendar events, mail, chat and Drive files — but acts as the agent's own identity rather than as you, using its ak_ API key. Requires a key from Admin → People & Access → New agent; install fails without one.
